description: Low, base and high are the value and the cited bounds already stored on each parameter. This file names the series. It does not keep a second copy of the number. Carbon is the exception: it is not a plant parameter, and its two cases are the charges in config/analysis.json.

series.note: One cited price. The parameter file has no low and no high.
Base is the 2026 supplier quote. Low is the 2016 pre-feasibility figure.
Base is the grid tariff. High is Hall's round-the-clock renewable price, which is a different product.
Base is the BEE 2011 valuation. High is the Bhardwaj buy-back converted at 95 INR per USD.
Hall tender range, converted at econ.usd_inr.

carbon.note: Base is no carbon charge at the plant gate. High is the Q3 2026 CBAM certificate price. Neither is marked the official case.
